reason: Bridge -> Reasoning. `given` asserts "Export control is a mature enforcement instrument; model-distillation has no equivalent statute", and two bridges this week attack both halves. The 2026-07-26 bridge (validation.92ea7a5157b125ad) carries NYT reporting that Washington's preferred mechanism is deliberately NOT a docketed instrument - "sanctions, procurement pressure and soft signalling assembled into a slow-motion ban rather than announced as one", leaving "no single instrument a self-hoster can read and comply with" - which undercuts the inference from mature machinery to the `so_that`/`landing` requirement of a publicly filed action naming Moonshot or the Thailand route. The 2026-07-28 bridge (validation.51a5d1c91b207ab3) then records Treasury Secretary Bessent warning Chinese AI firms could face sanctions over intellectual-property theft - a named instrument pointed at the distillation half, which is the prediction's own second falsifier. Reframe `given` to distinguish "has an instrument" from "will use a filed instrument", and acknowledge that a sanctions track now exists on the provenance side. `because` remains accurate as historical fact.
